paragraphs.text: Zo-Zu , the Punisher (ZOH-zoo; Japanese: ゾーズー; rōmaji : Zō-Zū ), was a reclusive akki of Kamigawa , who made his home wandering in the Sokenzan Mountains .

He acquired an ancient relic, a set of crystalline swords that let him deflect raw mana . Zo-Zu was a scourge to all who traveled the Mountains; humans , kami , and akki alike. His primary tactic was to simply whack large shots of red mana at any intruder who came into his territory.
